mainEntity.name: How much does a Denago golf cart cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Denago golf carts start at $8,995 for the SCOUT 2 and range up to $16,500 for the street-legal CITY model. Most models fall between $9,995 and $12,995.

mainEntity.name: Are Denago golf carts street legal?

acceptedAnswer.text: The DENAGO CITY is a street-legal NEV/LSV with lights, mirrors, seat belts, and a 25 mph top speed, legal on many roads posted 35 mph or less depending on state law. Other models can be configured for street-legal use in many areas.

mainEntity.name: What battery do Denago golf carts use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every Denago runs on maintenance-free LiFePO4 lithium batteries backed by an 8-year factory warranty — no watering, no acid, thousands of charge cycles.

mainEntity.name: How far can a Denago golf cart go on a charge?

acceptedAnswer.text: Estimated range is 40 to 70+ miles per charge depending on model. The OXEN utility cart leads at 70+ miles.
